meta.calculation_method: Previous available trading close before Sep 21 to Sep 25 close

one_line_week: Mega-cap technology led a positive week while small caps and market breadth lagged.
highlights: QQQ and MAGS materially outperformed the broad market.
IWM finished the week lower, showing weaker small-cap participation.
Technology led sectors while energy and utilities declined.
benchmark_takeaways: Growth leadership was clear: QQQ +3.19% versus SPY +1.27%.
Small caps diverged: IWM -0.75% for the week.
leadership_notes: The strongest configured baskets were technology-heavy.
Headline index gains masked weaker participation across many individual stocks.
sector_notes: Information Technology was the strongest S&P 500 sector for the week.
Utilities and Energy were the weakest sectors.
breadth_title: Breadth was weaker than the headline indices
breadth_notes: MarketWatch reported 302 of 503 S&P 500 constituents down for the week.
A separate tracked-stock universe showed only 39% of stocks advancing.
macro_notes: The 10-year Treasury yield rose from roughly 5.01% to 5.17% over the week.
Crude fell sharply while gold finished modestly higher.
